label: Pastoral Equipment & Wool Handling
volunteer_identification_guide: Fleece classing equipment, wool bale stencils, hand/blade shears, mechanical handpieces, wool scales, bale hooks, wool bins, and wool press components.

label: Stationary Machinery & Engines
volunteer_identification_guide: Stationary petrol/kerosene engines (e.g. Ronaldson-Tippett, Lister, Southern Cross), pumps, water jacks, overhead lineshafting, pulleys, drive belts, and generators.

label: Workshop & Trades Tools
volunteer_identification_guide: Blacksmith forge tongs, anvil, swage block, hardy tools, farrier rasps, leg vices, drawknives, adzes, broadaxes, and pit/crosscut saws.

label: Domestic Furniture & Fittings
volunteer_identification_guide: Cast-iron bedsteads, bush timber tables, benches, larders, meat safes with wire/zinc mesh, washstands, cedar chests, and shearers bunks.

label: Stove Cooking & Hearth Equipment
volunteer_identification_guide: Cast-iron kitchen ranges (e.g. Metters Dover, Crown, Esse), camp ovens, flat irons, cast-iron kettles, hearth cranes, spit hooks, and baking alcoves.

label: Historic Bottles Tins & Packaging
volunteer_identification_guide: Embossed shearers oil and grease tins, kerosene tins, tobacco/match tins, crown-seal and aerated water bottles, stone ink/ginger beer jars, and packing crates.

label: Loose / Salvaged Architectural Fabric
volunteer_identification_guide: Salvaged shingles, hand-wrought spikes, Ewbank cut nails, cast-iron butt hinges, rim locks, sash weights, moulded architrave offcuts, and marked bricks.

label: Personal Items & Apparel
volunteer_identification_guide: Elastic-sided work boots, leather saddlery remnants, belt buckles, bone buttons, clay/briar tobacco pipes, pocket knives, and pencil leads.

label: Other Portable Heritage Item (Specify)
volunteer_identification_guide: Unique or unclassified artefact requiring full descriptive notes in table and cross-reference to detailed sketches or macro photos.
